Tiffany & Co. (known colloquially as Tiffany or Tiffany's) is an American luxury jewelry and specialty retailer, headquartered in New York City . It sells jewelry, sterling silver, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, water bottles, watches and personal accessories, as well as some leather goods.
Tiffany is renowned for its luxury goods and is particularly known for its diamond and sterling silver jewelry. It markets itself as an arbiter of taste and style. Many of these goods are sold at Tiffany stores, as well as through direct-mail and corporate merchandising.
In 1919, the company made a revision to the Medal of Honor on behalf of the United States Department of the Navy. This Tiffany Cross version was rare because it was awarded only for combat, using the previous design for non-combat awards. In 1942, the Navy established the Tiffany version for non-combat heroism as well but, in August 1942, the Navy subsequently eliminated the Tiffany Cross and the two-medal system.
In 1956, legendary designer Jean Schlumberger joined Tiffany, and Andy Warhol collaborated with the company to create Tiffany holiday cards (circa 1956–1962).[14][21] In 1968, Lady Bird Johnson, First Lady of the U.S. at the time, commissioned Tiffany to design a White House china-service that featured 90 flowers.[22][23]
In November 1978, Tiffany & Co. was sold to Avon Products Inc. for about US$104 million in stock. However, in a 1984 Newsweek article, the Fifth Avenue Tiffany store was likened to the Macy's department store during a white sale, due to the high number of inexpensive items on sale; furthermore, customers complained about declining quality and service. In August 1984, Avon sold Tiffany to an investor group led by William R. Chaney for US$135.5 million in cash. Tiffany went public again in 1987 and raised about US$103.5 million from the sale of 4.5 million shares of common stock.
Due to the 1990–1991 recession in the United States, Tiffany commenced an emphasis upon mass merchandising. A new campaign was launched that stressed how Tiffany could be affordable for all; for example, the company advertised that the price of diamond engagement rings started at US$850. “How to Buy a Diamond” brochures were sent to 40,000 people, who called a toll-free number specifically set up to target the broader population. However, to maintain its image as a luxury goods company, high-style images remained on display in Tiffany stores.

High-poly seesaw for small children from about 3 - 6 years of age, made from Robinia wood. Modelled according to the European standard for (public) playground equipment EN 1176. A swimming pool, swimming bath, wading pool, paddling pool, or simply pool is a structure designed to hold water to enable swimming or other leisure activities. In-ground pools are most commonly constructed from materials such as concrete, natural stone, metal, plastic, or fiberglass, and can be of a custom size and shape or built to a standardized size, the largest of which is the Olympic-size swimming pool.
Many health clubs, fitness centers, and private clubs have pools used mostly for exercise or recreation. Many towns and cities provide public pools. Many hotels have pools available for their guests to use at their own leisure. Educational facilities such as high schools and universities sometimes have pools for physical education classes, recreational activities, leisure, and competitive athletics such as swimming teams. Hot tubs and spas are pools filled with hot water, used for relaxation or hydrotherapy. They are common in hotels and health clubs, and can also be found in many private homes. Special swimming pools are also used for diving, specialized water sports, and physical therapy, as well as for the training of lifeguards and astronauts. Swimming pools may be heated or unheated.

description_text:
Modern turnstile conceptualised to match modern day pandemic scenario. Designed keeping in mind that turnstile and token trasaction kiosks are a point of convergence for a crowd and close proximity should be avoided. Also the idea that a user must not feel clustered or isolated thus avoiding the use of opaque walls and glasses. Thus a turnstile with glass barriers was thought. The scanners can be placed on either sides of entry keeping both left handed and right handed users in mind such that minimum time is spent at such a place where crowd converges. Best suited for place of public gathering like metro stations, bus stations, airports, offices,etc
Glass barriers are keyed with a driver and driven set key constraints. UVs are mapped and equal texel density is maintained.
Do provide with feedback and ideas if you feel there is a problem worth ideating for modern day solutions

This model is a high-end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project. The model is highly accurate and based on the manufacturer's original dimensions and technical data.
The model was initially created and fully textured in Blender 2.91, then rendered using Cycles.

All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results. Some or all of the materials and textures may be made with Blender's shader nodes. You will get the best results in Blender.
No extra plugins are required for this model. Lights and cameras are not included in the scene.
If this model has stl extension in the file list, stl files have not been tested by printing. If you have any questions while printing, feel free to contact me.

description_text:
A LED display is a flat panel display that uses an array of light-emitting diodes as pixels for a video display. Their brightness allows them to be used outdoors where they are visible in the sun for store signs and billboards. In recent years, they have also become commonly used in destination signs on public transport vehicles, as well as variable-message signs on highways. LED displays are capable of providing general illumination in addition to visual display, as when used for stage lighting or other decorative (as opposed to informational) purposes.
BioTech Industries is a fictional brand name that I use on all sci-fi models**
Hand-painted using Substance Painter. PBR - AR/ VR - Low-Poly
Google, YouTube, Unity and Unreal Engine Friendly
Game-ready
Textures; 2048 x 2048, OpenGL, Dilation + Single Background Colour, 16 Pixel Padding
Maps Include; Base, Normal, Height, Rough, and Metal.
Screen is a separate object part and texture to enable easy exchange/ animation
Please note; This may, or may not 3D Print. Not tested.

description_text:
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Golden Snitch from Harry Potter made in Catia V5 and rendered in Keyshot 9 Pro.
Quidditch /ˈkwɪdɪtʃ/ is a fictional sport invented by author J.K. Rowling for her fantasy book series Harry Potter. It first appeared in the novel Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (1997). It is a dangerous but popular sport played by witches and wizards riding flying broomsticks.
Matches are played on a large oval pitch with three ring-shaped goals of different heights on each side, between two opposing teams of seven players each: three Chasers, two Beaters, the Keeper, and the Seeker. The Chasers and the Keeper respectively score with and defend the goals against the Quaffle; the two Beaters bat the Bludgers away from their teammates and towards their opponents; and the Seeker locates and catches the Golden Snitch, whose capture simultaneously wins the Seeker's team 150 points and ends the game. The team with the most points at the end wins.

description_text:
This soccer field model is built to match FIFA standard dimensions for pitch and goal size. The mesh is optimized for a lower polygon count while maintaining the silhouette's shape integrity. It consists entirely of triangles and quads (no n-gons), ensuring clean geometry for all applications.
High-Quality PBR Textures The model features 4K PBR textures that deliver realistic results across various lighting conditions. The texture set includes:

  -   • Albedo

  -   • Metalness

  -   • Roughness

  -   • Opacity

  -   • Ambient Occlusion (AO)

  -   • Normal (GL)These textures provide relatively high texel density even when viewed up close. For example, the pitch grass texture has a texel density of 12 px/cm. If needed, textures can be downscaled to 2048×2048 while still maintaining acceptable texel density. All AO textures are pre-configured in Blender and ready to connect to material shaders.

*Multiple Formats *& Render Compatibility The model is available in multiple formats: Blend, FBX, GLB, and USDZ. It has been tested and works with both Eevee and Cycles render engines, as well as most other 3D viewers and software. Note that some 3D applications may require manual texture setup upon import.
Blender File Organization The provided Blender file is well-organized with named collections and objects. It includes two goal versions:

  -   • Textured net (using an opacity texture) – default version

  -   • 3D mesh net (fully modeled geometry)

Customizable Billboard Signs The billboard signs feature generic names and logos. Their texture and UV layout are designed for easy customization using Blender or image editors like GIMP, Krita, or Affinity Photo. A dedicated UV map for the signs is included for seamless texture replacement. A PDF document with instructions and information on the Blender file, UVs, and Collections is included (in the texture folder). Technical details

  -   • Number of objects: 23, goals (2 versions) corner flags, field, substitute benches, signs.

  -   • Total vertices count: 33,565

Preview Renders & Scene Setup The preview renders use HDRI background textures from Polyhaven.com (not included in the Blender file). However, the Blender file includes a dynamic sky setup with a ready-to-use scene containing a camera and pre-configured settings for both Eevee and Cycles.
Texture Quality Options Textures are provided in both JPG (default, for efficiency and smaller file size) and PNG (higher quality) formats.
 The model has been checked and verified for:

  -   • Face direction (normals)

  -   • Applied modifiers

  -   • Scale and rotation (applied)

  -   • Origin point placement

  -   • Loose geometry (removed)

  -   • Internal faces (removed)

  -   • Face sides (consistent)

description_text:
Level Tool
Ah, the mystical and marvellous construction-level tool! Picture this: it's like a trusty sidekick for construction workers, the Batman to their Robin, the yin to their yang. This magical contraption is a superhero of sorts, swooping in to save the day and ensure that everything is perfectly straight and level.
Imagine a miniature Gandalf, armed with a staff and wearing a tiny hard hat, standing tall and proud, shouting, You shall not pass, crookedness! This tiny wizard is the construction-level tool, ready to vanquish any lopsidedness or wonky angles that dare to challenge the integrity of a building project.
With its sleek body, it boasts a long and slender profile that makes fashion models jealous. It's a slender, sleek stick of justice, laser-focused on achieving perfection. With a bubble-like eye, peering through a transparent window, it sees all and knows all, ensuring that not a single degree of tilt goes unnoticed.
The construction level tool is like a referee at a dance-off, making sure everyone stays in line and dances on the straight and narrow. It refuses to tolerate even the slightest misalignment, glaring at any nail, brick, or tile that dares to deviate from its ordained path. It's a strict disciplinarian, doling out levelness with the sternness of a headmaster, keeping the chaos of slanted surfaces at bay.
But don't let its seriousness fool you! This tool knows how to have fun. It's like a prankster with a mischievous grin, toying with your perception of gravity. Just when you think you've got everything level, it throws you a curveball, a devious giggle escaping from its bubble eye as it reveals the hidden truth of your wonky construction.
In the hands of a skilled worker, the construction level tool is a conductor, orchestrating a symphony of straight lines and right angles. It's like a maestro, directing an architectural masterpiece with a flick of its bubble-filled wand. With a flick here and a tilt there, it brings harmony and precision to the chaotic dance of construction.
So, next time you see a construction level tool in action, give it the respect it deserves. It's not just a tool; it's a comedy magician, a guardian of symmetry, and a straightness superhero all rolled into one.

description_text:
Burj Khalifa - designed and created in Revit and Revit Family 2019
Formats: .rvt .fbx
This model of Burf Khalifa as you can see in images is based on 4 parametric Revit Families. (Sky wire at the top, Railings, Floors and Bottom Floors )
Sky wire, Railings and Bottom floor are a little more easier modelled, but Floor Revit Family is most complex one and with just this one family you can created every floor from bottom to the top.
For better performance i didnt created nested main Revit Family from these 4 Families, but put them straight into the model, because it was crashing, But if you change detail level from fine to medium, it will hide some elements, so model will be very fast and clear.
Materials are created from default library from Revit.
Every Revit Family here has similar parameters, so in the main model you can find them merged in Global Parameters in manage tab such as:Materials for slabs, glass and metal elementsHeight for slabsWidth and Depth for all Facade elementsWidth for Facade ringsHeight for all railings
All complex models such as vegetation, people, cars and some advanced furniture (which can't be created in Revit) are imported from Revit plugin Enscape and only by this program you can render them properly. In other 3d programs(3dsmax, Blender,...) they will show up with low poly faces and can't be used like in Revit and Enscape.
  - All my models are made from scratch in Revit or Revit Family with maximum quality and precision. In the end, you should be able to use it for many similar different projects. If this project contains some parametric Revit Families, you should see them in preview images. If you may know, Revit Family is a sub-program for Revit. You can create models in more complex and different shapes as usual in Revit, and if you put the right parameters for it, you can update this kind of family in more different shapes and sizes, if you have parameters set right. In my all Revit Families on this website, i'm always trying to create and add parameters for main dimensions such as width, height, depth and more and always changeable materials, if you want to put different textures.
For rendered pictures was used program Enscape. I hope u like it :)

description_text:
Authentic Jurassic Park Main Gate 3D Model
Bring a piece of cinematic history into your projects with this highly detailed and accurate recreation of the iconic Jurassic Park main gates from the 1993 film.
This model was created with game integration in mind, making it a great asset for game engines or cinematic projects. The included PBR texture maps are provided in both 4K and 2K resolutions, offering the flexibility to choose between high fidelity for renders or performance for real-time applications.
As a fan of the franchise and a fellow 3D artist, I used this model in my personal project, Jurassic Explorer (version 0.4), which was built in Unreal Engine. You can find a link to the project in my bio, which showcases the model's seamless integration and visual quality in a real-time environment.
Whether you're a filmmaker, a game developer, or a Jurassic Park enthusiast, this model is an excellent addition to your asset library.
Textures included:

  - Albedo / Base Colour

  - Metallic

  - Roughness

  - Normal Map

  - Ambient Occlusion

Feel free to ask for any technical assistance.
Please note: The .FBX and .blend files have been tested and work correctly.

Every mesh in the pack is closed and optimized for real-time rendering. Each model contains collision mesh and it is available in 3 file formats: blend, fbx and obj. Models are scaled according to metric system.
Depending on dedicated usage, each model is provided with 3 sets of textures containing following maps:

  - PBR Metallic/Roughness workflow: Base Color, Roughness, Normal (DirectX), Ambient Occlusion, Metallic; totally 75 16 bit png files, 

  - Unreal Engine 4: Base Color, Normal (DirectX), combined Ambient Occlusion (red channel), Roughness (green channel) and Metallic (blue channel); totally 60 8 bit png files, 

  - Unity: Albedo, Normal (OpenGL), Ambient Occlusion, combined Metallic (RGB) and Smoothness (alpha channel); totally 60 png files.

In order to use our models in preferred game engine please follow official guidelines of its provider.
HDR backgrounds not included.
All meshes in MOUNTAIN ROCK PACK were created using photogrammetry and were optimized for real-time rendering. Models are provided with custom 4K PBR textures allowing for easy building of consistent and detailed environments, which can be used in games, architectural visualisations, animations and still images.

description_text:
An imaginary location in Vecna’s mind representing his ‘curse’ power.
This scene is a low poly reprentaiton of a deconstructed version of the Creel’s House at the center of Vecna’s Mindscape. 
The whole model includes:

  - Main organic black tree

  - Damaged brick wall

  - Creel's door

  - Hardened black sludge ground

  - Old broken staricase

  - Organic black spikes (2 different models)

  - Floating rocks

  - Floating wood rubble

  - Old broken wooden wall (2 different models)

  - Fog cube

  - Cloudy environment created with Dynamic sky

The entire project was developed in Blender. All materials and resources are included. Textures and colors of each object shows a realistic representation of the location. If you want a more red ambientation like the one in the show, you can use #E0673C.
Check out this Instagram effect where a 360 render of this scene was applied: https://www.instagram.com/ar/368264468822124/
Hope you enjoy it!

description_text: The Space Shuttle was a groundbreaking spacecraft and a symbol of human space exploration. Developed by NASA, the Space Shuttle was a reusable vehicle designed to transport astronauts, satellites, and other payloads into space. It consisted of three main components: the orbiter, which carried the crew and payload, the solid rocket boosters for initial propulsion, and the external fuel tank for liquid fuel storage. The Space Shuttle played a pivotal role in numerous historic missions, including the deployment of satellites, construction and maintenance of the International Space Station, and the famous Hubble Space Telescope repair. Its unique ability to launch like a rocket and return to Earth as a glider allowed for cost-effective space operations. The Space Shuttle program spanned over three decades, inspiring generations with its technological advancements and pushing the boundaries of human exploration. While the program has come to an end, the legacy of the Space Shuttle continues to influence future space endeavors, leaving an indelible mark on the history of space exploration.

description_text:
This is a scene to showcase multiple assets I have created. They are fully textured, optimized and game ready. This product is not an environment, it's an assets packs. The environment is just to showcase the assets. Although it is included if you want to mess with it, go ahead.
What you will find in this pack:
-27 Assets in total (models and high-res PBR textures)
-17 of them are completely unique, others are a variation
-The assets are in indiviudal folders, but I have also provided them in one single environment file (FBX, OBJ and in a Blender file)
-I have included the HDRI from the trailer.
-Graffiti and footprint decal textures 
-Authored textures for the broken mirror material.
Friendly disclaimer:
-The texture files are zipped and cannot be linked to the blender file. So the BLENDER SCENE DOES NOT have textures. You're gonna have to manually insert them. Or you can try importing the FBX file which DOES have textures.
-The provided scene is not lit, I have only provided the same HDRI you see in the trailer.
-The pipes, walls and floor assets are not modular, they fit this specific scene only.
-Pills and pill containers were added for a dramatic effect in the video trailer and are NOT included.
This bathroom is a reconstruction based on the one found in Joker (2019). It is old, creepy and abandoned. The lighting is green and orange as seen in the movie.

Originally built on unproductive farm lands, it is now among residential suburbs in the south of the Perth metropolitan area, within the City of Cockburn, and just south of Leeming and west of Canning Vale.

description_text:
Road Sign - Speed Limit Pack - Universal 004
This pack includes 11 speed limit road signs. All the models included are PBR.
All Kuimi Models are originally created in Blender 3D / Cycles Render.
Our Team is made by professional designers and 3D artists, and we are working hard to give the best result possible to our models in an accessible price!

Preview Images rendered in Blender using Cycles Render (Please, note that the scene and lighting or anything that is not the model are not included).
All designs and arts in our models are made from scratch by our designers, including Logos, and general designs, there are no copyrighted brands, logos or any kind of resources. 
GEOMETRY

  - 11,438 Tris (each)

  - 5,750 Verts (each)

  - 6,107 Faces (each)

ABOUT THE MODEL

  - PBR

  - Single Mesh Models

  - All Materials Baked in one single texture 

  - All objects named correctly 

  - Model ready to be used! (no clean scene process needed)

  - The original model was made in Blender 3D

FILE FORMATS

  - Blend (original)

  - OBJ

  - FBX

  - DAE

  - STL

  - ABC

  - GLT

TEXTURES (8192 x 8192, 4096 x 4096 and 2048 x 2048)

  - Color

  - Roughness

  - Metallic

  - Normal

BEFORE PURCHASE
Please, consider downloading one of our free 3d Models, and check if everything Works Well in your software, using the native files or Universal Files (OBJ, FBX). Also check the quality of the model! 
PINK MODEL ERROR!!
If you are using a .Blender File, and the model was loaded pink, it means that the software could not find the correct path for the textures! please try to use “File > External Data> find missing files” to find the correct path for the textures (it should not happen, but if happens please contact us to solve the problem in the asset)
QUESTIONS
If you have any question about how to use or setup the model, report something wrong, or make some request, please contact us via support! 
Thank you!

description_text:
This pack contains 3 medieval magic store model levels, which allow you to upgrade the building being perfect for RPG/strategy fantasy and other game. Inspired by medieval architecture these models in conjunction with other medieval buildings allow you create a town straight out of the Middle Ages. Each element has been carefully crafted with in-game use optimization in mind. Everything has been optimized for games, mods or any real time applications: polycount, textures, UV maps atlases etc. This asset will work easily with mobiles & PCs. Like all our products this Medieval Magic Store is handy to use and easy to modify.
Main Features:
- 3D Assets:

  - 3 preassembled buildings.

  - Polycount props: 28 - 528 tris. 

  - Polycount buildings: 689 - 2403 tris. 

  - As a free bonus this pack also contains props assets like: scrolls, grass, candles, books, book stands, pot, potions, table. 

- 4 hand painted textures:

  - Each sawmill model levels use the same texture for a better optimization.

  - Building texture resolution: 2048x2048.

  - Ground texture resolution: 2048x2048.

  - Grass texture resolution: 256x256.

There is more models of this series – explore our models set! 
https://www.cgtrader.com/3dshapes
We intend very much. We hope you like it. Please rate this product, your honest review and rating will help us know that we're on track. Need help? Don't hesitate to contact us. Best regards 3dShapes!

description_text:
This model is based on real airplane slide, with real world dimensions. 
It is suitable for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games, other real-time apps or just in usual rendering.
Created in Blender, tested in Unreal Engine 4.21.1.
Number of faces: 5782Number of triangles : 11 486Number of vertices:  5911 (9110 in UE4) 
Real world dimensions: approx. 7,7m x 5,17m x 3,75m
Textures are 4096x4096 all in jpg. 
Metallic/Metalness workflow used.Textures: base color                   metallic                   roughness                  normal                   ambient occlusion (AO) (named as plugs in shader in Unreal Engine, or in Blender) 
Note: Be sure to use textures (mainly roughness and metallic) except base color as non-color data
           to avoid strong reflections.  Check it for two sided/double sided. 
In Unreal Engine uncheck sRGB in texture editor. Appearance depends on Your lighting. Preview images have been rendered in Blender Cycles and Unreal Engine 4.Model has been multiple times checked and rendered. In spite of that, if You have any problem with it or just have any question, please don't hesitate to contact us.
Thank You for your prospective purchase.

description_text: Greek sporting events were closely linked to religion, and therefore games were held at religiously important places or sacred sites. The competitions, held every two or four years and lasting for centuries, included Zeus at Olympia (from 776 B.C.), Apollo at Delphi (from 586 B.C.), Poseidon at Isthmia (from B.C.). It was to honor a particular god or demi-god, such as (from 580 BC) and Opheltes of Nemea (from 573 BC). These constituted the four great Pan-Hellenic Games; However, other locations in the Greek homeland and islands also hosted regular sports festivals. The oldest competition at these Games was a foot race over a certain distance - the stade or stadium, which was 600 meters long. Since the foot (or pous) was not strictly standardized across Greece, a stadion could vary in different places, from 177 m long at Delphi to 192 m at Olympia. At Nemea, small poles survive along the side of the track marking every 100 meters across the stadium

description_text:
A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea, or on a lake or river. Many different kinds of vessels are used in commercial, artisanal and recreational fishing.
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.[2][1]
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

This high-efficiency 3D model represents a professional-grade white single-chip LED floodlight, a cornerstone of modern industrial and architectural lighting solutions. Unlike traditional incandescent or halogen fixtures, this LED-based unit utilizes advanced semiconductor technology to convert electrical energy directly into visible light, resulting in significantly lower thermal dissipation and enhanced luminous efficacy. The design typically features a robust aluminum alloy housing that serves as an integrated heat sink, ensuring optimal thermal management for the internal electronics. A single high-power LED chip is positioned at the focal point of a precision-engineered reflector, allowing for a concentrated yet widely distributed beam pattern suitable for both spotlighting and broad-area illumination. The exterior is finished in a durable white powder coating, providing corrosion resistance and a clean aesthetic that blends seamlessly into contemporary architectural environments. Such fixtures are ubiquitous in urban landscaping, security lighting, and commercial signage due to their exceptional lifespan, which often exceeds 50,000 hours of operation. Additionally, the single-chip configuration minimizes chromatic aberration and provides a uniform color temperature, making it ideal for tasks requiring high color rendering and visual clarity. This digital asset captures the technical nuances of the hardware, from the glass lens seal to the mounting bracket assembly, making it suitable for architectural visualization and product rendering.

description_text:
Ancient temple of the jaguar - entrance, based on my own concept.Made using 3dsmax, Zbrush, Unfold3D, Substance Painter. Preview images are rendered using Vray Next. There are also previews from Zbrush and 3ds max and Blender viewports.
This is not game-ready model. It is modular, so you can use its parts to create something else.
Package contains -

  - 3ds Max files NATIVE - two versions of topology - one is from Zbrush, remeshed (946.7k polygons). Other one is optimized using 3ds max's ProOptimizer (426k polys)

  - FBX files for both versions

  - Blender file - only imported mesh (shaders must be adjusted!)

  - Textures - high resolution TIF maps, mostly 4096x4096. They can be converted to .jpgs and reduced without much loss in quality. They can be used as PBR, every texture set has diffuse (albedo), roughness, glossiness and normal maps.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact me

Do not hesitate to ask any questions.

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY
Geometry provided is low poly mesh. Mesh is subdividable up to its original sculpt level of 6 to accurately reveal all tiny details of displacement map.Model is designed to provide optimal detail/performance level you need. Not only high detail close-up renders are possible, but lower subdivision level/not subdivided mesh can also be used in game environments.

  - Geometry centered on the origin

  - Real world scale (units: centimeters)

  - Polygonal quads only

  - No poles with more than 5 edges

  - Displacement distance (useful in other software packages):  1.0 cm

  - UVs: linear

TEXTURES
Textures are photorealistic 8192x8192 (32 bit per channel EXR) images, created from real object capture data.Each model UV's were created and inspected according to its specific surface characteristic. This enables to find the optimal balance of maximum texture space allocation, intuitive layout, easy further 2d texture editing possibilities and minimal texture distortion.Textures are designed to fit linear UVs (no internal smoothing, locked UV borders) to avoid UV smoothing errors. Geometry of evenly sized quads guarantees low linear UV texture distortion when subdivided.
Textures used in provided Blender scene:

  - Albedo

  - Roughness

  - Vector Displacement

  - Spherical 16384x8192 HDRI map texture

Additional textures provided in separate archive:

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

No third-party plug-ins used.Scene created in Blender 2.8.
Feel free to leave your feedback. It should help me to better know your needs and actual product reception. My goal is to provide high quality models and constantly improve various aspects of them. Thank you!

description_text:
Intro
I bet your second half did not think buying a 3D printer is a good idea, well, printing a gift of the vase may prove someone wrong! Highly detailed model of the vase is made in such a way as to allow for modular assembly. You can scale it as you want of course, but modularity allows for smaller size parts to be assembled later on.
Technical Info
Print parts one by one, then just glue them together. If you prefer to use one material, you can print the vase as one solid block (if it fits into your printer of course), this approach is faster and would save substantial amount of support material, which is otherwise needed when printing parts separately. The drawback of printing the vase as a solid block is that you loose aesthetical quality when nicely differentiating curved sections.

description_text:
Intro
This wavy plate is great to hold fruits or other items. The bigger the plate you are going to print the better. If it will be very small and lightweight, non-symmetrically placed items may flip the plate over, thus stability can become an issue. Another important thing to note is that it is best to use non-transparent glossy plastic for this plate as in some parts plate can be quite thin and thus transparency can have unpredictable aesthetic result (it is of course possible that the effect may be positive).
Technical Details
Plate's surface was scripted to form randomized wavy pattern, thus waviness forms non-repeating natural ornament. Script also allowed the surface to go totally smooth on the edges, forming nice and sharp curved corners around the plate.

.max (3ds Max 2010 for separate models).max (3ds Max 2010 for the scene, whose models are presented as XRef Objects with Proxy Object option).max (3ds Max 2012 for the scene, whose models are presented as XRef Objects with Proxy Object option).obj (low poly).obj (high poly).fbx (low poly).fbx (high poly)For all the scenes with XRef Objects, the Proxy Object option for quick saving of the file edition and Viewport drawings is usedAll paths in the scene are relative to the project folder3d model are located in corresponding layers for easy scene managementNamed objects\materials\layers for easy navigationRender Plugin – V-Ray2.0—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—— To use our product you need 3ds Max 2010 or higher, and VRay 2.0 or higher.Standardized scene arrangement, easy-to-use setup will let you effectively use our product in the process of designing and projecting.Named object layers and material allow you to orientate yourself in the wide range of scenes and make the whole work process much easier.XRef links simplify the basic scene by reducing the file’s size and increasing the speed of work in viewports due to the fact that models have their low-poly copies for proxy representation. The link system is arranged in such a way that customer is able to change mapping and material of the models directly
in the scene without correcting the external original file, that is, the same original model may have each own unique color solution in each of your
scenes.Absolute advantage of such approach is the small size of the work file which gives an opportunity to use regular equipment without using expensive
professional machines.If for some reasons you are not a fan of using external links in your projects – don’t get upset. Our product is completed with the scene where all the
models are presented in the original mesh.

description_text:
Coal Model Pack - Black Brown Anthracite
This Pack can be used to build custom piles of cole, heaps of coal or as base for scattering coals in your environments.With the 5 different low poly cole pieces come 3 types of pre-arranged cole piles and 3 heaps of cole ready for you to use.
As you can see in the wireframe the mesh resolution is fairly low, with this you should not encounter any problems if you use the models extensively,even if you dont use instanced geometry.
The textures are high resolution, 4096 x 4096All maps ecept the worn edges are seamless, so you can decide wich level of detail you want to use or wich area you want to cover.
Models:-Coal Pieces - 5 different types-Coal Pile - Small-Coal Pile - Medium-Coal Pile - Large-Coal Heap - Small-Coal Heap - Medium-Coal Heap - Large
Textures for Antracite Coal, Black Coal and Brown Coal each:-Color-Color Heap-Roughness-Roughness Heap-Normal-Normal Heap-Worn Edges -Displacement (This pack is not really meant for displacement, but to a certain degree you can use it)
Enjoy!

description_text:
High-quality low-poly PBR 3D model of Big Wind Turbine.
The turbine blades part is separate objects so they can be animated and there is also a default turbine blades animation in these models.
This 3D model was built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry.
I have made every effort to ensure that the PBR textures are as detailed as possible and made with the greatest care. 
Technical details:

  - 2 PBR textures sets (Main Body, Alpha)

  - 9352 Triangles

  - 10282  Vertices

  - The model is divided into 2 objects (Main Body and Blades)

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the optional animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

PBR texture sets details: 

  - 4096 Main Body texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, AO)

  - 2048 Alpha PBR texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal)

Available file formats:

  - Blender 2.9 (.blend)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.4 (.mb)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact us first.
We will try to make the model printable but we will let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

  - If you are not sure about something in this 3D model then feel free to email us and ask before you buy.
We will try to reply as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. We can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

description_text:
A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea, or on a lake or river. Many different kinds of vessels are used in commercial, artisanal and recreational fishing.
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.[2][1]
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

description_text: Scaffolding is a crucial component of construction and renovation projects, providing a temporary framework that supports workers and materials as they reach heights and access hard-to-reach areas. This intricate network of metal or wooden structures ensures safety and efficiency on job sites by offering a stable platform for tasks such as painting, plastering, welding, or even building maintenance. Scaffolding not only enhances the productivity of skilled laborers but also plays a vital role in minimizing the risks associated with working at elevated levels, exemplifying its indispensable role in the construction industry's quest for precision and safety.

  - About DesignBiomimicry or biomimetics is the science that studies nature as a source of inspiration for the design of innovative solutions (technological, architectural, process…) to solve human problems.The main idea behind biomimetics is that nature is millions of years ahead of humans in any field, and for that reason it’s very advantageous to be inspired by it or to copy it directly. The term was popularized by scientist and author Janine Benyus with her book “Biomimicry: Innovation Inspired by Nature” in 1997. In the book she talks about a new science that studies the models of nature and then imitates these designs and processes to solve human problems. “Today we are faced with a challenge that calls for a shift in our thinking, so that humanity stops threatening its life-support system. We are called to assist the Earth to heal her wounds and in the process, heal our own – indeed to embrace the whole of creation in all its diversity, beauty and wonder.” ~ Wangari Maathai

As the world becomes more in tuned with the planet’s plight, more industries have chosen to make the commitment to Going green. The jewellery industry is no different. Interestingly, the designers have taken different approaches to help create a culture of sustainability. While they are making a conscientious effort to either embracing or saving nature, they also place high emphasis on the aesthetics and design of the jewellery. Today, we’ll look at three ways designers have incorporated nature into their design:
After a mad rush to establish the concrete jungle, we’ve started to realise just how much of an impact nature has on our physical and emotional wellbeing. Being in nature, or viewing scenes of it, can lift your mood and even reduce stress, muscle tension and blood pressure. Thus, these designers were inspired by nature and incorporated real foliage and flowers into their design.Ocean Petals Art Studio by Jasenka created a collection of botanical pieces that are rustic and feminine. Being an avid gardener, Jasenka grows and collects all the tiny elements that she works with – such as bark and foliage fragments – from her family garden in a sustainable way. Whilst in university she studied Botany, Forestry and Horticulture, where she learnt the art of drying and pressing flowers. To create her jewellery, she preserves them in eco resin to create the intricate pieces. By using this form of resin, she keeps the jewellery eco-friendly while achieving the visual result.Erin LaRocque chose to get her materials through foraging for foliage and wood in Michigan’s Hiawatha National Forest. Because she isn’t manipulating the vegetation, there isn’t an identical pendant within the collection. Just like Jasenka, she also works with resin to preserve her unique findings. She showcases her handmade creations under her online shop her shop BuildWithWood.
Then there are the designers who want their customers to interact with living, growing plants. Passion Flower Made created botanical jewellery by incorporating succulents into the jewellery design. Designer, Susan McLeary, models succulents taken from her garden and creates statement pieces which can stay fresh for up to three weeks. Of course, you’ll need to take care of the creation in the same way you would with your house plants. After that, the client can gently peel them off the jewellery and repot them so that they can continue to thrive. The jewellery underneath is also designed to be a strong stand-alone; giving the client two for the price of one.Icelandic designer Hafsteinn Juliusson had a similar idea and created the Growing Jewellery. This limited-edition collection incorporated moss into handmade pieces fashioned from silver. When well maintained, which includes watering and trimming the moss, the plant can stay green for up to 12 weeks. The clash between organism and couture was in an effort to bring people in metropolitan cities closer to nature.
Our need for instant gratification means we’re going through products faster than ever before. But what happens to your discarded TVs, mobile phone, or computer. Most likely, it ends up in a landfill further contributing to the waste management problem. However, what if it could be broken down and given a second life in jewellery?
Recycled Beautifully was started by Celina Ortiz and her husband to create wire jewellery from spare TV parts. The ‘Tree of Life’ necklaces use cooper and aluminium wires that are found in older versions of TV sets. They are then wrapped around a variety of stones such as agate, opal and turquoise to fashion pendants.Gulnur Ozdagar turned to the most readily available waste-material to create jewellery; PET bottles. Their stellar range of luminous pieces features everything from crowns and earrings to hairpins and necklaces that are all made from upcycling these bottles.Jewellery artist, Dana Hakim Bercovich, gets her inspiration from the metal mesh of speakers. This mesh, which is designed to protect the internal components of the speaker, is moulded to create brooches, necklaces, earrings and bracelets of beautiful geometric shapes.
DonateYou’re design process can already be green, but some designers decide to take it a step further. They either contribute money or resources towards environmental initiatives or try they literally get their hands dirty for more greenery.
Brilliant Earth specialises in engagement rings that are ethically and sustainably made. Apart from using conflict-free diamonds, which are sourced from only ethical mines that observe strict environmental and labour standards, they also work with recycled diamonds and lab created ones too. In addition, they’ve partnered with the environmental non-profit One Sky and the Conservation Society of Sierra Leone to restore land that was ravaged by unregulated mining to organic agriculture practices.
Pame Designs is a fan-favourite among Hollywood celebrities. Its collection of bracelets, rings, earrings and necklaces are designed by Pam Sweeny from sustainable materials that carry meaning and invite conversation. With the aim of preserving and protecting oceans and rivers, she donates a portion of all sales to organisations such as Surfrider and Waterkeeper Alliance.
Nueva in the Spanish language means new. Thus, Anueva Jewellery works with recycled gemstone, gold and silver to create their eco-friendly product. In addition, with each purchase made, designer Jennifer Vinje donates to Plant-It 2020. This organisation plants trees in no-logging zones.

description_text:
Famous landmark from each country in the world.
This project aims to create every single most famous landmark of every country in the world. This one pack contains the countries ranging from N to O (A total of 12 Countries).
The countries contained in this pack are:
-Namibia, Nauru, Nepal, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nicaragua, Niger, Nigeria, North Korea, North Macedonia, Norway and Oman.
Each monument/ landmark is labelled with the name of the country and the monument itself.
Technical details: All the models share the same material with the same texture and roughness map, there is 2 versions of the same texture: 24x24 px and 240x240 px (it can be upscaled even more if necessary).
Cards are included individually inside a zip file in full resolution made for a5 print size. All of them have a front and a dorso.
Export file formats are .FBX .GLB .STL .PLY .OBJ and native is .blend

description_text:
Famous landmark from each country in the world.
This project aims to create every single most famous landmark of every country in the world. This one pack contains the countries ranging from R to S (A total of 20 Countries).
The countries contained in this pack are:
-Romania, Russia, Rwanda, South Africa, Samoa, San Marino, Sao Tome & Principe, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Serbia, Seychelles, Sierra Leon, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, Solomon Islands, Somalia, St Kitts & Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent & The granadines.
Each monument/ landmark is labelled with the name of the country and the monument itself.
Technical details: All the models share the same material with the same texture and roughness map, there is 2 versions of the same texture: 24x24 px and 240x240 px (it can be upscaled even more if necessary).
Cards are included individually inside a zip file in full resolution made for a5 print size. All of them have a front and a dorso.
Export file formats are .FBX .GLB .STL .PLY .OBJ and native is .blend

description_text:
Basalt Columns and Rocks Kit PBR - Natural
Description:This 19 part Kit allows you to build your own realistic basalt rock structures. Or if you want, just use the included samples. You can create whole basalt sceneries with the prefabricated parts in no time.The overall polycount is low and the asset is game ready, you can also subdivide it and use the included displacement maps for even more detail.  While the mesh resolution is low I added enough loops to make the formations deformable in the end, so you can add the nice bends that basalt sometimes shows!
The sample screens are just plain geometry and normal mapping, IF you want to use displacement make sure you add some holding edges to avoid texture stretching. All textures are high resolution 8k, feel free to create any lower resolution from it.
3d Asset suitable for all render engines and realtime render engines. A production ready Cycles scene for Blender is included.
Models:    Basalt Columns, non deformed 4x    Basalt Columns, deformed 4x    Basalt Rocks 4x    Basalt Cluster low    Basalt Cluster High    Basalt Cluster Wall    Basalt Cluster Overhang    Basalt Cluster Slope    Basalt Structure small - Hill    Basalt Structure big - Cliff
Textures:    Basecolor /Diffuse    Normal DirectX    Normal OpenGL    Normal Clean (directly from bake, no 2d details added)    Roughness    Metallness    AO    Displacement    Environment HDR
Enjoy rendering!

description_text:
Basalt Columns and Rocks Kit PBR - Obsidian
Description:This 19 part Kit allows you to build your own basalt rock structures with obsidian look. Or if you want, just use the included samples. You can create whole sceneries with the prefabricated parts in no time.The overall polycount is low and the asset is game ready, you can also subdivide it and use the included displacement maps for even more detail. While the mesh resolution is low I added enough loops to make the formations deformable in the end, so you can add the nice bends that basalt sometimes shows!The sample screens are just plain geometry and normal mapping, IF you want to use displacement make sure you add some holding loops to avoid texture stretching.
All textures are high resolution 8k, feel free to create any lower resolution from it.The obsidian look is of course not native to basalt, but I think the geometric formations of basalt and the obisian material complement each other very well. I also included a texture variant with red/orange vains instead of the grey ones.
3d Asset suitable for all render engines and realtime render engines. A production ready Cycles scene for Blender is included.
Models:Basalt Columns, non deformed 4xBasalt Columns, deformed 4xBasalt Rocks 4xBasalt Cluster lowBasalt Cluster HighBasalt Cluster WallBasalt Cluster OverhangBasalt Cluster SlopeBasalt Structure small - HillBasalt Structure big - Cliff

Grass for landscaping exterior
The archive has:
Tuned lawn through CoronaScatter To repeat the lawn, I saved all the CoronaScatter settings and distribution map settings See them in the folder Corona Scatter
The archive has: 2014 MAX (Corona + VRay) + FBX + MAT (Corona + VRay) FBX and VRay files contain the geometry of grass blades and not the entire lawn. Saved .MAT file (for both Corona and VRay) for use with FBX geometry

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY
Geometry provided includes 3 low poly meshes. Each mesh is subdividable up to original sculpt level of 6 to accurately reveal all tiny details of displacement map.Model is designed to provide optimal detail/performance level you need. Not only high detail close-up renders are possible, but lower subdivision level/not subdivided mesh can also be used in game environments.

  - Geometry centered on the origin

  - Real world scale (units: centimeters)

  - Polygonal quads only

  - No poles with more than 5 edges

  - Displacement distance (useful in other software packages):  1.0 cm

  - UVs: linear

TEXTURES
Textures are photorealistic 4096x4096 (32 bit per channel EXR) images, created from real object capture data.Each of 3 meshes has its own uv map and textures.Each model UV's were created and inspected according to its specific surface characteristic. This enables to find the optimal balance of maximum texture space allocation, intuitive layout, easy further 2d texture editing possibilities and minimal texture distortion.Textures are designed to fit linear UVs (no internal smoothing, locked UV borders) to avoid UV smoothing errors. Geometry of evenly sized quads guarantees low linear UV texture distortion when subdivided.
Textures used in provided Blender scene:

  - Albedo

  - Roughness

  - Vector Displacement

  - Spherical 16384x8192 HDRI map texture

Additional textures provided in separate archive:

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

Additional Ground plane geometry and its textures (8192x8192) provided in separate archives:

  - Ground_rotten.obj (1536 polygons)

  - Albedo

  - Roughness

  - Vector Displacement

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

No third-party plug-ins used.Scene created in Blender 2.8.
Feel free to leave your feedback. It should help me to better know your needs and actual product reception. My goal is to provide high quality models and constantly improve various aspects of them. Thank you!

description_text:
ARCHIGLASS PRO - BLENDER CYCLES ARCHITECTURAL GLASS SHADER
Is architectural glass different from the standard one used for house windows?
Yes, and that's why real-world architectural glass is very difficult to translate into CGI: the material has physical and optical properties that differ greatly from standard glass
Archiglass Pro has the most important properties of the real material:  
1) Double Index Of Refraction 
At steep angles, the objects behind the glass will have two displaced diffractions
2) Coloration based on view angle
The wavelength function has been reproduced using available physical data
3) Differently colored rim
A complex node-based geometry recognition setup has been created specifically for this shader, to automatically generate different color and properties to the sides of the mesh
4) Reflectivity slider
In addition to the typical glass reflectivity, Archiglass Pro has a property slider that adds reflections on top of the transparency  
5) Random deformation and roughness
To further enhance realism, there is an optional random-per-tile roughness and displacement property. When increased above zero, it will add slight deformations to the glass
Please do note that only the material is included in the file: models and scenes in thepictures may be included in different products in the future

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of New York taxi car.  The Interior part is also modeled and textured but with less detail.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 4743 Triangles

  - 2634 Polygons

  - 2853 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into the main part and wheels.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the animation process.

  - Model is scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
Approached by the talented Sone of the UK based Paint Wasters (PWS) to design, create and print a representation of his style writing graffiti based upon a piece painted at the Al Fresh Co store. I tinkered with it a little further to make it less delicate to print and also added some cracks.
Follow him on instagram: @sonearlynot
I have made it in 3 pieces to allow for a bigger print on smaller printers. I found using quite heavy supports allowed for a cleaner print but time and care is needed removing them.
Printing at 0.15mm layer height, with 50% infill. The 3 pieces combined take a total of 24 hours 8 minutes and uses 149.1g of filament.

description_text:
The most significant recent developments in Canadian coinage were the introduction of $1 and $2 coins and the withdrawal of the one cent piece. The $1 coin (the loonie) was released in 1987. The $1 banknote would remain in issue and in circulation alongside the one dollar coin for the next two years, until it was withdrawn in 1989. The coin was to be the voyageur-design silver (then nickel) dollar coins that had previously been in limited circulation. The dies were lost or stolen in November 1986, requiring a redesign.[citation needed] The new coin is colloquially called the loonie, for the common loon on its reverse, and the name is frequently applied to the currency unit as well. It is made of nickel plated with aureate bronze. The $2 coin, carrying a polar bear, was introduced in 1996. It is usually called the toonie and is bimetallic. The $2 banknote was withdrawn at the same time that the coin was released. Unlike several U.S. attempts to introduce a dollar coin, the new coins were quickly accepted by the public, owing largely to the fact that the Bank of Canada and the government forced the switch by removing the $1 and $2 bills from circulation.
Between 1997 and 2001, the $1 loon coin was not issued for general circulation. Due to the high demand for the $2 polar bear coin (mintages between 1997 and 2001 were as high as 29 million in 2000 alone), the $1 coin was only produced for the standard collector sets that were made available on an annual basis, such as the Uncirculated, O Canada, Specimen and Proof sets.

description_text:
ENGLISH:Band Geeks follows Squidward, who recruits the citizens of Bottom to play in a marching band for the Bubble Bowl. The episode received widespread acclaim, with many fans and critics considering it the best episode of the entire series
Squidward Tentacles gets a call from his wealthy former high school classmate and rival, Squilliam Fancyson, who has succeeded in everything in which Squidward has failed, including music. Squilliam reveals to Squidward that he has become the leader of a band scheduled to play at a venue called the Bubble Bowl, but he will be busy at that time and cannot attend. Squilliam derisively suggests that Squidward's band should substitute for his at the Bubble Bowl, correctly believing that Squidward does not have one. However, Squidward defiantly insists that he has a band and accepts the challenge. He assembles a large marching band composed of various Bottom residents.
During their one week of training, the band performs consistently poorly and fails to improve at all. On the last day of practice, the band members start blaming each other for their poor performance, and a brawl ensues. As band class ends, the band members instantly stop fighting and start filing out of the building. Before they leave, Squidward appears outside, expresses his disappointment in them, despondently tells them to not perform and goes home, distraught over his failure. However, SpongeBob convinces the other band members to go through with the performance for Squidward's sake, and he takes command of their training.
On the day of the concert, Squilliam shows up at the venue entrance, where Squidward claims that his band died in a marching accident. The band then immediately arrives, and Squidward reluctantly proceeds with the performance. They enter the Bubble Bowl, a large glass dome that elevates them into a live-action football stadium full of human fans. Squidward cringes in fear as he conducts the band, but, to Squidward's surprise, the band is tremendously successful, playing Sweet Victory for the crowd. Squilliam enters a state of shock and faints, leaving Squidward to triumphantly conduct the band and celebrate.
Z: 110mm.
SPANISH:
Band Geeks sigue a Calamardo, quien recluta a los ciudadanos de Fondo de para tocar en una banda de música para el Bubble Bowl. El episodio recibió elogios generalizados, y muchos fanáticos y críticos lo consideraron el mejor episodio de toda la serie.
Calamardo Tentáculos recibe una llamada de su rico ex compañero de secundaria y rival, Squilliam Fancyson, quien ha tenido éxito en todo lo que Calamardo ha fracasado, incluida la música. Squilliam le revela a Calamardo que se ha convertido en el líder de una banda programada para tocar en un lugar llamado Bubble Bowl, pero que estará ocupado en ese momento y no podrá asistir. Squilliam sugiere burlonamente que la banda de Calamardo debería sustituir a la suya en el Bubble Bowl, creyendo correctamente que Calamardo no tiene ninguna. Sin embargo, Calamardo insiste desafiante en que tiene una banda y acepta el desafío. Reúne una gran banda de música compuesta por varios residentes de Bottom.
Durante su semana de entrenamiento, la banda se desempeña constantemente mal y no mejora en absoluto. El último día de práctica, los miembros de la banda comienzan a culparse unos a otros por su pobre desempeño y se produce una pelea. Cuando termina la clase de la banda, los miembros de la banda instantáneamente dejan de pelear y comienzan a salir del edificio. Antes de irse, Calamardo aparece afuera, expresa su decepción hacia ellos, les dice abatido que no actúen y se va a casa, angustiado por su fracaso. Sin embargo, Bob Esponja convence a los otros miembros de la banda para que sigan adelante con la actuación por el bien de Calamardo, y él toma el mando de su entrenamiento.
El día del concierto, Squilliam aparece en la entrada del lugar, donde Calamardo afirma que su banda murió en un accidente mientras marchaba. La banda llega inmediatamente y Calamardo, de mala gana, continúa con la actuación. Entran al Bubble Bowl, una gran cúpula de cristal que los eleva a un estadio de fútbol de acción real lleno de fanáticos humanos. Calamardo se encoge de miedo mientras dirige la banda, pero, para sorpresa de Calamardo, la banda tiene un gran éxito y toca Sweet Victory para la multitud. Squilliam entra en estado de shock y se desmaya, dejando a Calamardo dirigir triunfalmente la banda y celebrar.
Z: 110mm.

description_text:
Track & Field 200m indoor arena – Scaled Model with High-Quality PBR TexturesThis detailed track & field model is designed to scale and features hand-painted 4K PBR textures, making it perfect for real-time rendering in game engines, animations, or visualizations. The model includes setups for multiple athletic events and customizable props for added flexibility.
- Key Features:

  - Realistic PBR Textures:

  - Tree 4K UV maps with the following textures: Diffuse, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion (AO), and Normal.

  - Includes textures in both PNG and JPG format.

  - Optional baked AO texture is provided for additional shading control.

  - 37 objects, 97,424 Vertices

- Athletic Event Areas:

  - Running track with a 100m race setup, complete with starting blocks.

  - Facilities for high jump, long jump, triple jump, pole vault and more.

  - Additional Props:

  - Includes customizable billboards.

  - Customizable UV Layout:

  - Easily edit billboard designs or track colors by modifying the Diffuse texture in any image editor.

- Blender File Included:

  - The attached Blender file allows you to reposition props or make adjustments to suit your project needs.

  - Folder containing high-quality original textures.

  - Baked AO texture for optional use.

This track & field model is perfect for creating realistic sports environments in games, animations, or simulations while offering full customization options. The preview images shown are rendered using Eevee render engine in Blender but Cycles works also.

description_text:
A sailboat is a sail-driven vessel that uses wind power as its thruster. The ship's construction was generally made of wood and was long used as a shipping backbone both civilian and military until the discovery of steam engines and iron/steel vessels in the 19th century in line with the many Industrial Revolutions pioneered by the British through the invention of steam engines by James Watt.
At first, the sailboat was driven by human power as a rower and sail. Models of this type of ship can be seen on viking ships, Ancient Egyptian ships, Ancient Roman ships, Ancient Indian ships until the time of Borobudur Ships that have used sailboats. Along with the development, it is used kapa bercadik sails as found in Indonesia, ships using triangular sails such as those found in the Middle East and rectangular sailboats used by europeans towards the beginning of the century of exploration, as well as folding sailboats with models found in Japan or China.

description_text:
Here's my 3D printable model of the Odyssey, Ulysses 31's ark-ship, as he travels the Universe in search of the path back to Earth, accompanied by his children and companions in stasis, punished by the gods of Olympus for having the audacity to strike down the Cyclops and save his son Telemachus.
This Franco-Japanese anime from the '80s, a futuristic transposition of Homer's Odyssey, left me with excellent memories and, at the time, sparked my interest in Greek mythology. I think it has aged rather well, and I still watch some episodes with pleasure.
This impressive city-sized vessel, which even houses gardens, is teeming with detail. Its design, with an eye-shaped structure, allows for an impressive amount of visible surfaces, each sublimated by a multitude of shapes on the hull.
The model shown, printed to 100% scale, measures almost 600 mm wide. As usual, each part can be printed in the right color or painted before assembly to achieve a nice result, no need to be an experienced painter. The Make shown in the photos was printed with my Anycubic I3 Mega, in 0.1 mm layers. The model is delivered with pdf assembly instructions, and I'm at your disposal for any support you may need. Happy printing to all.

description_text:
Ancient Altar -  Low Poly Model
For game experience you can add fire on the top of columns
Model is inspired by ancient architecture.
=============================
Materials included in Blender. In order to work in cycles and EEVEE you need to assign all of the textures (different path).
No Third-party plug-ins usedTurntable of model rendered in Blender Cycles( worse quality for time improvement)
Available all formats of an object, including Blender, FBX, OBJ, PLY, MDD, PC2, DAE, STL.( Properly exported)
Bare in mind that pbr materials to work properly need proper lighting and material setup. If you have a problem just ask.
RAR file contains:

  -  Height Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

  -  Normal Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG DirectX

  -  Normal Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG OpenGL

  -  Glossiness Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG

  - BaseColor Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

  - AmbientOcclusion Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

In the files high poly version included ( around 5 milion faces) - RAR file
Model is positioned at the beginning of the coordinate system (0,0,0) [Blender 2.8] Scale = 1:1:1 

  - Polygons =1353 

  - Vertices =1354 

  - Triangles = 2706 

Asset tested in Unity Engine (Unity 2018.1 (64-bit)) and (Unity 2018.2 (64-bit)) Also tested in Unity's LWRP and HDRP.

Ancient Altar Texture Version 3 -  Low Poly Model
For game experience you can add fire on the top of columns
Model is inspired by ancient architecture.
=============================
Materials included in Blender. In order to work in cycles and EEVEE you need to assign all of the textures (different path).
No Third-party plug-ins usedTurntable of model rendered in Blender Cycles( worse quality for time improvement)
Available all formats of an object, including Blender, FBX, OBJ, PLY, MDD, PC2, DAE, STL.( Properly exported)
Bare in mind that pbr materials to work properly need proper lighting and material setup. If you have a problem just ask.
RAR file contains:

  -  Height Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

  -  Normal Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG DirectX

  -  Normal Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG OpenGL

  -  Glossiness Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG

  - BaseColor Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

  - AmbientOcclusion Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 

In the files high poly version included ( around 5 milion faces) - RAR file
Model is positioned at the beginning of the coordinate system (0,0,0) [Blender 2.8] Scale = 1:1:1 

  - Polygons =1353 

  - Vertices =1354 

  - Triangles = 2706 

Asset tested in Unity Engine (Unity 2018.1 (64-bit)) and (Unity 2018.2 (64-bit)) Also tested in Unity's LWRP and HDRP.

description_text:
[NOT-LIGHTMAPPED VERSION] 
This pack contains all furniture and decoration in the SHC QuickOffice modular asset pack. 
This asset pack is made out of building components and furniture that fits perfectly together with their textures/materials, sizes, lightmaps and LOD. All parts are low-poly so it can be used in high amounts in big models for game development or other purposes. 
The SHC QuickOffice pack can be used to create large detailed modular 3d scenes in very little time and combines realistic graphics and realtime performance very effective. 
For any questions, help or information, feel free to contact me!
Available files: -3DS (textured) -DAE (Textured, UVmapped, Lightmapped*) -FBX (textured) -OBJ (textured) -SKP (textured) (added for easy quick modify and conversion)
*Lightmaps are only available when purchasing the lightmapped versions, these lightmaps are produced in Blender.) Lightmaps are maps with rendered lighting baked into it. This means that the model has a more realistic appearance without extra render power (ideal for real time situations like games, promotion and VR)

The Arsenal Football Club, commonly known as Arsenal, is an English professional football club based in Holloway, North London. Arsenal compete in the Premier League, the top flight of English football.
In domestic football, Arsenal have won 13 league titles (including one unbeaten title), a record 14 FA Cups, two League Cups, 17 FA Community Shields and a Football League Centenary Trophy. In European football, they have one European Cup Winners' Cup and one Inter-Cities Fairs Cup. Arsenal were also runners-up in the 2005–06 UEFA Champions League. In terms of trophies won, it is the third-most successful club in English football.[2]
Arsenal was the first club from the South of England to join the Football League in 1893, and they reached the First Division in 1904. Relegated only once, in 1913, they continue the longest streak in the top division,[3] and have won the second-most top-flight matches in English football history.[4] In the 1930s, Arsenal won five League Championships and two FA Cups, and another FA Cup and two Championships after the war. In 1970–71, they won their first League and FA Cup Double. Between 1989 and 2005, they won five League titles and five FA Cups, including two more Doubles. They completed the 20th century with the highest average league position.[5] Between 1998 and 2017, Arsenal qualified for the UEFA Champions League for nineteen consecutive seasons.

.max (3ds Max 2010 for separate models).max (3ds Max 2010 for the scene, whose models are presented as XRef Objects with Proxy Object option).max (3ds Max 2012 for the scene, whose models are presented as XRef Objects with Proxy Object option).obj (low poly).obj (high poly).fbx (low poly).fbx (high poly)For all the scenes with XRef Objects, the Proxy Object option for quick saving of the file edition and Viewport drawings is usedAll paths in the scene are relative to the project folder3d model are located in corresponding layers for easy scene managementNamed objects\materials\layers for easy navigationRender Plugin – V-Ray2.0—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—-—— To use our product you need 3ds Max 2010 or higher, and VRay 2.0 or higher.Standardized scene arrangement, easy-to-use setup will let you effectively use our product in the process of designing and projecting.Named object layers and material allow you to orientate yourself in the wide range of scenes and make the whole work process much easier.XRef links simplify the basic scene by reducing the file’s size and increasing the speed of work in viewports due to the fact that models have their low-poly copies for proxy representation. The link system is arranged in such a way that customer is able to change mapping and material of the models directly
in the scene without correcting the external original file, that is, the same original model may have each own unique color solution in each of your
scenes.Absolute advantage of such approach is the small size of the work file which gives an opportunity to use regular equipment without using expensive
professional machines.If for some reasons you are not a fan of using external links in your projects – don’t get upset. Our product is completed with the scene where all the
models are presented in the original mesh.
