description_text:
Telecommunications Tower environment asset. Real world scale (around 20 meters tall). Photo-realistic asset with 4K RGB packed PBR texture maps.
Mostly quads topology with 4,707 faces and 5,438 verts. When converted to tris, the total tri count is 8,934). Clean mesh with no shading errors, n-gons, co-planar faces, or isolated vertices.The UV space is cleverly constructed using overlapping UVs to maximise efficiency. Even though the tower is quite large, even 2K map resolution looks relatively good. However, 4K textures are included for close up renders.
The interchange formats were tested.
Unreal Engine file is ready to use in any project and has materials, real world scale, collision (automatically generated complex as simple) and automatically generated lightmap UVs.
Please set Maya units to Meter. The file should have relative filepaths.

description_text:
A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea, or on a lake or river. Many different kinds of vessels are used in commercial, artisanal and recreational fishing.
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.[2][1]
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

description_text:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of a futuristic building, ideal for your scenes/concepts. Ideal for futuristic city skylines but also detailed enough for closer shots. This model is based on my own concept, it's modeled in 3dsmax. It's simple to arrange it in different scale and composition.
IMPORTANT NOTICE - 3dsmax is native software for this model. You can use it in any other 3D software as well, but you'll need to create shaders/materials with provided textures. Materials I created are fairly simple and I didn't use many textures at all, mostly procedural shaders and colors. There is a marmoset preview for you to inspect the geometry.
Downloadable content:

  - NATIVE 3dsmax files (versions 2023 and 2020) - Corona material-ready

  - FBX file

  - OBJ file

  - Blender scene (imported mesh only, shaders must be created manually)

  - Textures

If you have any questions, feel free to ask.

description_text:
Subway Traffic Light in Game Ready. A set of traffic lights for use in the subway. There are several options for floor-mounted traffic lights with boxes and several wall-mounted options for installation on subway tunnel tubes. All variants of Emissive textures are available for any combination of traffic light colors. Perfect for the Unreal Engine & Unity.
Features:

  - Hight Quality Model & Materials

  - PBR Materials

  - Reasonable poly count

  - Optimized the density of the textures

  - Several color options for emissive textures

  - Maps Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic are collected in ORM packages

Technical details
Available file formats:

  - Blender Scene (Native)

  - Unity 2022 [Built-in | URP | HDRP]

  - FBX

  - OBJ & MTL

  - STL

  - USDC

  - PNG for Textures

3D Specification:

  - 8 Unique Mesh

  - 8 Materials

  - 10 Textures 4096x4096 

  - Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM Pack (Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic), Emissive

Textures ZIP file:

  - 13 Textures 4096x4096

  - Maps: BaseColor, Normal, Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic, ORM Pack, Emissive

Range of Tris:

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_visor - 23428 Tris / 13025 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light - 22198 Tris / 12221 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_visor - 19552 Tris / 10932 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB - 18732 Tris / 10396 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_for_wall_visor - 14068 Tris / 7635  Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_for_wall - 12838 Tris / 6831 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_for_wall_visor - 10192 Tris / 5554 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_for_wall - 9372 Tris / 5018 Verts

Unity Specification:

  - 9 PBR Materials

  - 10 Textures

  - Texture Sizes: 4096*4096

  - Textures Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM (Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic in package), Emissive

  - 1 Shader (for Built-in)

  - 8 Meshes

description_text:
Animated with a liquid simulator, 250 frame of realistically flowing fountain water, shooting upwards then falling to the ground. 
The file itself is an ALEMBIC file, ie. and .abc file. Also enclosed a 3ds max scene file, but you need to browse for the alembic file there.
An OBJ and FBX files are also attached but they are only a still frame of the fountain water flow.
You can drag and drop to any scenes into your 3d application which accepts .acb files. 
All the main 3d applications supports .abc files, here is a list of 3d applications which supports .abc files:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alembic_(computer_graphics)
Apply any material, there are three examples in the previews, rendered in vray, but you can render it in any engine with any materials.
The fountain example scene is only for presentational purposes, that scene is NOT part of this 3d model.
You can set a custom timeframe, or you can just use it as a still frame. If you have any questions, let me know.
Thank you, sincerely yours,Motionblur Studios Team

description_text:
EV charging stationA charging station, also called electric vehicle charging station, electric recharging point, charging point, charge point, electronic charging station (ECS), and electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), is a machine that supplies electric energy to charge plug-in electric vehicles—including cars, neighborhood electric vehicles, trucks, buses, and others.
Some electric vehicles have onboard converters that plug into a standard electrical outlet or a higher voltage outlet. Others use custom charging stations.
Charging stations provide connectors that conform to a variety of standards. For common direct current rapid charging, chargers are equipped with multiple adaptors such as Combined Charging System (CCS), CHAdeMO, and AC fast charging.
Public charging stations are typically found street-side or at retail shopping centers, government facilities and parking areas.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia:To the Struggle Against World Terrorism (also known as the Tear of Grief and the Tear Drop Memorial) is a 10–story sculpture by Zurab Tsereteli that was given to the United States as an official gift from the Russian government as a memorial to the victims of the September 11 attacks in 2001, and the 1993 World Trade Center bombing. It stands at the end of the former Military Ocean Terminal in Bayonne, New Jersey. Ceremonial groundbreaking occurred on September 16, 2005, in a ceremony attended by Russian President Vladimir Putin. The monument was dedicated on September 11, 2006, in a ceremony attended by former U.S. President Bill Clinton.

description_text:
Medieval&Fantasy Set is a 3D models and materials package for games and visualizations. With this package you can create your own medieval village from zero, or enriching your project with some additions. The preview pictures have been taken within a Unity scene, where I created a scene using only the assets included in this package, except for vegetation and particles, which comes from the amazing Meadow Environment asset from Nature Manufacture. The package contains the .fbx models and the textures to create PBR materials, not the scene in the preview.
In this package are included 118 3D models UV mapped and 35 texture folders, each of them to create a PBR material.The different files in the package are organized as follows:1) 3D models are in .fbx format, subdivided in 5 main categories that you can find in the FBX files folder. In the .fbx file models have only Diffuse map applied, but when you decide the software to render, you can apply the other maps.Suggestion: if you want to put them inside a game project, you should create LOD stages, in order to keep performances high (you can just use the decimate modifier in Blender for example).
01_Gate&Walls - 8 models, 69826 verts, 85022 faces02_Doors&Windows - 17 models, 107435 verts, 117954 faces03_Building_bases&samples - 36 models, 1058416 verts, 1132512 faces04_Wooden_elements - 20 models, 34651 verts, 44065 faces05_Stairs&street_elements - 37 models, 134096 verts, 144689
2) Textures are inside Texture maps folder. Each of the subfolders contains a number of texture maps, mainly in 4K (4096x4096), for Physically Based Rendering (PBR), so you usually find 4 different textures: Albedo/Diffuse, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion, Normal. Some materials also have a Metallic map, or a Displacement map if you want to use it.They are subdivided in 5 zip folders.
Enjoy the package, and if you have any question contact me at eli.luo93@gmail.com

Enjoy!

description_text:
Seven big, chunky, game-ready rocks in various sizes for your real time 3D project. All assets have been carefully designed to look great and highly detailed from all angles. Lots of cavities and interesting shapes make it easy to combine these rocks with 3D terrains and create an appealing and very varied look.
All these versatile rocks come with textures both for classic deferred and PBR rendering. On top of that we added five sets of detail maps which can help to achieve a crisp and sharp look even from close distance (provided your rendering pipeline supports detail map rendering).
Contents:
Seven rock assets in Blender, OBJ and FBX formats with following polycounts:

  - Rock L01: 1,834 Tris

  - Rock L02: 2,030 Tris

  - Rock L03: 2,312 Tris

  - Rock L04: 1,702 Tris

  - Rock M01: 1,700 Tris

  - Rock S01: 1,572 Tris

  - Rock S02: 1,966 Tris

Following texture maps are included in 2048x2048 resolutions – uniquely created for each asset:

  - Diffuse

  - Specular

  - Normal Map (Y-)

  - Normal Map (Y+)

  - Albedo

  - Ambient Occlusion

  - Smoothness

  - Smoothness + Metallic (works best with Unity’s standard shader)

And on top of that you also get five detail maps (Albedo/Normal) in 1024x1024 resolution.
Any questions? Don’t hesitate to contact us!

description_text:
This is my version of the Twilight Zone Eyes of the beholder mask
This was always my favorite episode and I loved the masks they were so recreated one to use for fun or for Covid. 
The mask is designed to use cloth of any kind in the air inlets and use a plug to hold the material in place, I still need to finish the plug design but for now the material could just be pushed into place. I should have the plugs finished in the next few days but I wanted to go ahead and get this mask uploaded for the public to try out.
I designed this with printing in mind, and have printed my own out with supports only at the base of the mask, to help keep the fine detail in the print. if your machine does bridging well then this should be fine for you also but some machines might require more support then others.  
Everyones face is differenent so I cannot design this to fit everyone perfect but I have tried to make it universal the best I can. If you want a perfect fit please pay attention to the scale or use some sort of liquid rubber around the edge.  I used Scandy Pro to 3d scan my face to base my mask shape off of. 
Please, Do not share/resale the 3d model
I don't mind selling of the prints as long as GrizzlyMountainDesigns is refered as the modeler :) Please feel free to message with any other questions or reguests! for even better deals, check out our patreon at patreon.com/grizzlymountaindesigns
If you like my designs/models check out our instagram Grizzlymountaindesigns or on the patreon, same name!
I do custom models so let me know if there's anything you think would be a good hit!

description_text:
this set of Japanese arrowheads consists out different types of arrows that are historical used by Japanese hunters, warriors and samurai. archery was not just used for one purpose but was used for many different things. because of this, many different types of arrow heads were developed.
for example, some specific arrows were long, slender en light. these kind of arrows do not as much damage as arrows with larger heads but are much better at piercing light armor and tough hides, making them excellent for the many wars that japan waged . its also the type of arrow where the design reduced the amount of metal needed the most. Good steel used to be expensive in Japan after all.
a other example are the forked arrows. These are designed to hunt small animals and birds. because of their shape they have a higher chance to hit their target while also doing enough damage to catch them.
These models are based on real Edo period arrowheads that have been preserved.
Model information:

  - made for 3d printing.

  - textures are added in case of digital use.

  - based on real Edo period arrowheads.

  - quads only.

  - subdivision ready.

  - hand modeled.

  - low poly and optimal for real time render

Disclaimer – in case of printing these arrow heads in metal, please check with your countries law and regulations beforehand. Even although arrowheads like these are legal in most places, some countries prohibit the use and/or possession of metal arrow heads with cutting edges.
– in case of use for hunting, please note that not all of these arrow heads are traditionally used for this purpose, and those that are, are used for different types of targets. Pleas only use for hunting if you know what you are doing.
– Japanese arrow heads are traditionally made out of steel (Tamahagane or Oroshigane) or steel lamination. When replicating these arrow heads for use on an arrow shafts, pleas make sure to use a material of similar strength or better to avoid accidents.
– polymath maniac is not responsible for any damage or injuries caused by use or misuse of these arrow heads. When printed with a hard material, these arrow heads are considered weapons and should be treated with care and respect.

description_text: This is a model of an outboard engine gear case. Below, i'll explain how it works for someone that doesn't know.The power from the crankshaft of the engine is driven to the gear on the top pinion through the driveshaft, which is fited with a nut below the pinion. The pinion then delivers the power (rotational) to the 2 gears next to it. The gears are rotating with opposite rotation. (the pinion and gears are rotating all the time the engine is powerd on...) Then with a lever (which usually is placed on the left side of the outboard or to your remote control) the clutch which is between the gears, is moved to the desired direction. Then the clutch is fited with the gear (because of its shape) and as the clutch is mounted on the propeller shaft, it rotates the propeller, which eventually moves the boat. If we want to put in the other gear (reverse or forward) we move the clutch to the opposite gear. When the clutch is in the middle position, your engine is in neutral. All gears as long as the pinion and the clutch as placed inside the lower Unit of the engine and are sank into oil (to reduce friction and wear).Along with the native Solidworks file, you can also find parasolid, iges and step formats as well as stl, amf and 3mf. Polygon file is also attached. Can be used for 3D printing.

Das größte Kunstmuseum Schwedens ist das Nationale Kunstmuseum Schwedens. Das Gebäude, das sich in Stockholm befindet, beherbergt eine beeindruckende Sammlung von etwa 16.000 Gemälden und Skulpturen. Das Nationale Kunstmuseum ist auch für die Verwaltung von Kunstwerken in zahlreichen Schlössern verantwortlich, darunter Gripsholm, Drottningholm, Strömsholm, Rosersberg und Ulriksdal. Zusätzlich dazu betreut das Museum das Porzellanmuseum in Gustavsberg.

La Haye Sainte ist ein Gutshof an der Straße zwischen Charleroi und Brüssel. Er spielte während der Schlacht von Waterloo 1815 eine wichtige Rolle. Marshall Ney eroberte diesen Gutshof zum Abend des 18. Juni 1815 und wurde am späterem Abend wieder geschlagen und aus dem Gutshof vertrieben.
Das Modell enthält den fertigen Gutshof in den Maßstäben 1:1000, 1:100 und 1:56. Die easy print version für die einzelnen Häuser und die Mauern sind in dem Maßstab 1:100 angefertigt. Skalierung dafür:178%: 1:56139%: 1:72

description_text:
Earl Louis Curly Lambeau (/ˈlæmboʊ/ LAM-boh; April 9, 1898 – June 1, 1965) was an American professional football player and coach in the National Football League (NFL). Lambeau, along with his friend and fellow Green Bay, Wisconsin native, George Whitney Calhoun, founded the Green Bay Packers in 1919. He served as team captain in the team's first year before becoming player-coach in 1920. As a player, Lambeau lined up as a halfback, which in the early years of the NFL was the premier position. He was the team's primary runner and passer, accounting for 35 touchdowns (eight as a rusher, three as a receiver, and 24 as a passer) in 77 games. He won his only NFL championship as a player in 1929.
From 1920 to 1949, Lambeau was the head coach and general manager of the Packers, with near-total control over the team's day-to-day operations. He led his team to over 200 wins and six NFL championships, including three straight from 1929 to 1931. He is tied with rival George Halas of the Chicago Bears and Bill Belichick of the New England Patriots for the most NFL championships by a coach. Lambeau also coached eight players who went on to be elected into the Pro Football Hall of Fame. With players such as quarterback Arnie Herber and split end Don Hutson, his teams revolutionized the use of the passing game in football. After a falling-out with the Packers' board of directors, Lambeau left the Packers to coach the Chicago Cardinals and Washington Redskins, each for two seasons, before retiring in 1953.
For his accomplishments, Lambeau has been widely recognized and honored. He was named to the NFL 1920s All-Decade Team as one of the top halfbacks in the league's first decade of existence. He was an inaugural inductee to the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1963 and the Green Bay Packers Hall of Fame in 1970 in recognition for his role as founder, player, and coach of the Packers. Two months after his death in 1965, the Packers home stadium, which is still in use today, was renamed Lambeau Field in his honor.

description_text: This striking 3D model depicts a meticulously detailed reconstruction of a Neanderthal head based on scientific evidence and fossil records. The sculpture captures our ancient human relative with remarkable anatomical accuracy, featuring the species' characteristic robust facial features. The model showcases pronounced brow ridges, a wide nose, receding chin, and powerful jaw structure that distinguished Homo neanderthalensis from modern humans. The textured beard and facial hair blend into a realistic portrayal of how these prehistoric humans might have appeared. The weathered, rugged appearance reflects adaptation to harsh Ice Age European environments. Dimensions are 20 cm length, 20 cm width, and 3 cm thickness. This expertly crafted model is perfect for anthropology enthusiasts, educational institutions, museums, paleontological collectors, or anyone interested in human evolution. Ideal for 3D printing, educational displays, or scientific visualization.

description_text:
Derawar Fort is a fortress in Ahmadpur East Tehsil of Bahawalpur District in the Punjab, Pakistan. Approximately 20 km south of the city of Ahmedpur East,The forty bastions of Derawar are visible for many miles in the Cholistan Desert. The walls have a perimeter of 1500 metres and stand up to thirty metres high. Derawar Fort was originally founded as a Bhati fort in the 9th century CE, and renovated in 1732 by Nawab Sadeq Mohammad Khan.
What is Derawar Fort famous for?Derawar and the Desert Forts of Cholistan was submitted by the Pakistan Government in 2016 to be considered as a World Heritage Site.
I was Inspired by this huge architect then I decided to re-create in 3d model then I made it in Autodesk Maya it’s a low poly game-ready 3d model suitable for AR/ VR, Mix Reality, Metaverse, Unreal Engine & Unity.Included 8k PBR texture with fbx + obj + Source file. Please leave a comment and share your views on my work.
Thanks

Organic stone pots - Landscape builder (1- or 2-color)
A sphere landscape with plant-pots permeated with a organic net. Print some of the organic stone pots and build a individual landscape.
There are three spheres-pot parts available (small, medium, large) with 1-2 different organic structures. For the private use, you can as many print as you like, and then combine it to a landscape. There is also a three in one landscape composition available.

Images: The photos show the three two-color parts, printed with a sandstone like filament (spheres/pots) and green wood (organic net). I use 5 layers,so the pots are possible waterproof.

description_text:
Something I actually made years ago, before all the fictional stadiums I’ve uploaded, it’s the first stadium I ever made with gangways & concourses inside the stands connected to access/exit ways, so despite it’s not as good as my most detailed stadiums (that’s why I prioritized the upload of more recent stadiums), is still pretty good, besides being a big step forward in my improvement process.
It’s an old olympic stadium that became a football stadium that meets most of the international requirements without eliminating any stand, becoming a great football stadium while keeping the classic architectonic style.
You get both stadiums complete in separate files in OBJ, FBX, DAE, DXF & the native SKP, in which you’ll find a third file with both stadiums, you just have to use the scene tabs to shift between the two; which was the point of making this model.
Before conversion: 
Capacity= 46,549 people.
Lower tier= 28,575.
Higher tier= 16,054.
VIP tier= 1,920.
Press (not included in total)= 474; 136 with desks, 326 w/o desks and 12 in commentators boxes).
After conversion:
Capacity= 72,691 people.
Lower tier= 40,796.
Higher tier= 28,955.
VIP tier= 2,588.
VIP boxes= 56 (7 each).
Wheelchair positions and companion= 296 (148/148).
Press (not included in total)= 496; 136 with desks, 336 w/o desks and 24 in commentators boxes.
IMPORTANT: These images (except for the last six) were taken from the same OBJ file available on another marketplace through its viewer, all formats are rudimentary exports directly from the native SKP file. Also, the polygons and vertices I wrote on the corresponding fields are an average between the before and after versions, naturally, the after version has much higher numbers than the before version.

description_text:
Electrical distribution cabinet object -7- out of the electrical distribution cabinet collection.
PBR texture maps: 
The textures for the model were baked with a pixel resolution of 16k in Blender-2.82a, later I scaled down the textures to 8k.I personally think that a pixel resolution of 2k is more than enough for the most uses of this small object!

  - 2k, 4k and 8k pixel resolution

  - Base color map

  - Metallic map

  - Roughness map

  - Normal map

  - Ambient Occlusion map

  - Cavity map

  - Not overlapping uvs

Geometry: 

  - Polygons 658

  - Vertices 480

Included 3D formats:  

  - Blender-2.82a (blend)

  - Alembic (abc)

  - Collada (dae)

  - Autodesk FBX (fbx)

  - Alias/WaveFront Material (mtl) 

  - OBJ (obj)

  - Polygon File Format (ply)

  - Stereolithography (stl)

  - X3D (x3d)

  - gLTF (gltf)

  - DXF

Used software and 3d-model creator.
Here on CGTrader you can find some of our 3D models, which we use in our projects for our Software VIS-All-3D ( https://vis-all.de/ )

  - Modeled and textured with Blender 2.82a ( https://www.blender.org/ )

description_text:
These cars are rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender files, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this collection is calculated on it's combination of cars relationship to other MCE cars and collections.The lower priced MCE collections have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced collections.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
Thes cars are made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exteriors
*Detailed interiors (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engines (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed undersides
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The cars are linked into several objects to make them more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The cars are royalty free, so you are free to modify and use them in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Average objects per car: 45
*Average polygons: 105.000
*Average verticles: 53.000
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text:
Column is an important part of the ancient Roman Greek architecture. A Roman Greek column typically consists of three parts: column cap or column capital, column base and column body. Column bases even in Greek architecture are fairly simple and dominated by different round configurations, which is often called Doric base column. However, the caps have many varieties. In general, Roman Greek column capitals can be classified into simple doric style column, contemporary ionic style column and ornamental corinthian style column.  Each category of column design yet has several variations. The Doric order was one of the three orders or organizational systems of ancient Greek or classical architecture; the other two canonical orders were the Ionic and the Corinthian.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Copenhagen Windmill Building. Wings are separated to suit the animation process.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.  
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 3732 Triangles

  - 1965 Polygons

  - 2842 Vertices

  - Model is built with two meshes.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are centered to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Follow Rescue3D Assets !
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Rescue3Dassets
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rescue3dassets
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Rescue3DAssets
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rescue3dassets
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKuB8qTeRtiX0vye9qverw/
Website: https://www.rescue3d.com  
Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
This is a 3D model of a realistic tennis ball for 3Dsmax/Redshift/Vray. Felt (hair) was created using Ornatrix, so you will need to install the Ornatrix demo in order to render it. No need to buy a license, the demo is free (the only one you need to render).
You get:

  - A clean topology with clean uvs ball model with 2 materials (and 2 ids), the yellow and the grey part.

  - 2 versions of felt (hair of the ball), short for a newer/tidier look, and longer for a worn, used and fluffier look. The felt is an Ornatrix object,  collapsed and cannot be edited, it's ready for render.

  - Materials with procedural maps for Redshift 3.* and Vray 5  inside 3Ds max, and 4K textures of those maps if you need to render outside 3Dsmax. 

  - 3dsmax 2020 scene with lights and camera, already setup for  Redshift and Vray 5.

  - Ball and fur are attached to a dummy for rotation. If you don't need this, just unparent them. 

  - I've added alembic and OBJ versions of the fur and the ball (they are over 1M polys!), so that you can import them to Cinema4D, Blender, Houdini or Maya. The look you get might be different due to the differences between apps. Sample renders have been created with 3dsmax and Redshift and Vray when stated. Both Alembic and Obj versions should carry UVS to any 3D app of your choice. Warning! It won't look the same in other apps other than 3Ds MAX due to the fact that you are not using Ornatrix!

Enjoy!

description_text:
This is the 3d representation of  the Superbowl LIX logo. It contains PBR textures (Color, Metallic, Roughness, Height and Normal maps) . I've included the model of the trophy alone, if you want to use only it. The textures included are both for a generic trophy(without LIX written in it) as for the Superbowl LIX, you only have to change the Roughness, Normal and Height Maps.
Renders were made in Maya using Redshift, textures were painted in Substance Painter. The files also contains the HDR used in the render and the Substance Painter file, so you can change anything you like. 
"Super Bowl LIX is the upcoming American football championship game of the National Football League (NFL) for the 2024 season. The game is scheduled to be played on February 9, 2025, at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans, Louisiana.
The official logo follows the logo template established since Super Bowl LVI, with the Roman numerals featuring imagery representing the host city/region. For this event, the Roman numerals contain artwork by local artist Queen Tahj Williams—a figure in the community of Mardi Gras Indians. It marks the first time the NFL collaborated with a local artist on the design of a Super Bowl emblem.
The design—originally created with beads—features Mardi Gras inspired red, green, and gold-colored fleur-de-lis patterns (a symbol long connected with New Orleans and used as the logo for the New Orleans Saints), evoking the designs of ironwork balconies common in the city's architecture (particularly in the French Quarter).

Old Trafford is a football stadium in Old Trafford, Greater Manchester, England, and is the home of Manchester United. description_text:
A professional, high-quality 3D model collection of a Tennis Umpire Chair (Referee High Chair). This asset includes three distinct color variations (Classic Green, Elegant Maroon/Brown, and Minimalist White) complete with sun canopies and writing desk armrests. Modeled with precision and rendered with realistic materials, it is perfect for sports simulations, stadium visualizations, tennis court animations, and archival renderings.
[ FEATURES ]
High Quality Geometry: Clean, professional polygonal topology, optimized for both high-end rendering and seamless viewport performance.
3 Color Variations: Features 3 fully textured versions (Green with side panels, Maroon with side panels, and White open-frame skeleton).
Format Versatility: Native 3ds Max format with VRay setup, plus popular interchange formats (Blender, FBX, OBJ) for universal compatibility.
Accurate Scale: Modeled in real-world scale with correct proportions based on real tennis tournament equipment.
Ready to Render: Fully textured and shaded. Drop it into your scene and hit render instantly.
[ FILE FORMATS INCLUDED ]
3ds Max (.max): Native file, setup with V-Ray materials, textures, and lighting environment.
Blender (.blend): Fully compatible, materials applied and ready for Cycles/Eevee.
FBX (.fbx): Universal format with baked textures/materials embedded, ideal for importing into Maya, Cinema 4D, or Game Engines.
OBJ (.obj + .mtl): Standard wave-front format with accompanying material file.
[ SPECIFICATIONS & TOPOLOGY ]
Software Used: 3ds Max (Modeling) / V-Ray (Rendering)
Texturing/Shading: Fully textured with high-resolution maps.
UV Mapping: Clean, non-overlapping UV coordinates.

description_text:
The Realistic 1980s Pop Icon Bad Tour Dance Pose Statue is an exceptionally dynamic, PBR-ready 3D model that captures the raw, high-octane energy of the world’s greatest entertainer during his legendary late-1980s solo stadium tour peak. Frozen in a high-intensity mid-performance dance break, this full-body sculpture showcases the artist clad in his iconic multi-buckled leather performance jacket, complete with asymmetrical zippers, tactical arm straps, a heavy metal utility corset belt, and tight-fitted rock trousers accented by leg buckles. The character is depicted gripping a vintage stage microphone close to his chest while sustaining a masterful toe-balance lean. Positioned firmly on a low-profile circular marble-textured stage base, this digital sculpture is a magnificent masterpiece for pop culture collectors, rock-pop memorabilia enthusiasts, or hobby miniature painters.
Use: Music room centerpiece, 80s rock-pop collection ornament, premium recording studio desktop display, advanced scale model figure painting project.
Originality: A masterful study in mid-dance physical tension, highlighting realistic leather texture folds, detailed metal hardware buckles, and a gravity-defying stage posture.
Essential Value: A pristine digital sculpture explicitly engineered to keep individual jacket straps, zipper teeth, and fine curly hair strands highly defined, making it an incredibly satisfying model to print and paint.
Keywords (SEO): pop king 3d print, bad tour stl, buckled leather jacket 3d model, dirty diana singer statue, 1987 concert figurine print, heavy metal belt stl, microphone stage dancer sculpture, fbx obj stl.
Context of Use, Limitations & InspirationsContext: Perfect for placing alongside vintage 80s vinyl records, concert ticket stubs, custom glass cabinets, or as a premier premium gift for dedicated live music video historians.
Limitations: The extreme crouched dance posture creates unique negative spaces under the arms and between the bent knees. Strategic support placement is critical underneath the mic-holding hand, elbows, and jacket tails to avoid surface scarring during post-processing.
Inspirations: Heavily inspired by the iconic 1987 punk-rock infused short films, explosive world tour opening choreography, and premium collectible designer scale statues.
Technical & Manufacturing InstructionsMachine CompatibilityFDM Printers: Creality, Prusa, Anycubic, Bambu Lab (An outstanding candidate for large-scale statue printing using ultra-fine layer settings to accurately capture the detailed jacket straps).
Resin Printers (SLA/DLP): Elegoo Mars, Anycubic Photon, Phrozen Sonic (The ultimate choice at standard desktop scale to draw out absolute sharpness across the micro buckles and facial features).
Recommended MaterialsPLA / PETG: Carbon-fiber black, dark titanium, or matte dark gray PLAs yield a beautiful, premium appearance straight off the build plate.
Resin: High-tensile, ABS-like, or specialized tough gray resins are highly recommended to add critical durability to the thin microphone stand and outstretched fingers.
Recommended Print SettingsLayer Height: 0.10 mm – 0.14 mm (FDM) / 0.03 mm – 0.05 mm (Resin).
Infill: 25–35% (Using a heavier, denser infill pattern inside the lower legs and circular stage base keeps the model perfectly balanced).
Supports: Required. Clean tree or organic supports are mandatory under the chin, the microphone cord, both elbows, the lower jacket edges, and between the upper thighs.
Shells/Walls: 3–4 walls recommended for strong exterior layers.
Assembly & Finishing InstructionsPost-Processing: Use extreme caution and fine flush-cutters when snipping away support material near the narrow mic cord and curly hair clusters. Smooth down any support remnants using fine-grit sand-sponges to preserve the surrounding leather textures.
Priming & Painting: Apply a solid coat of dark gray or black primer. Paint the tactical suit a rich semi-gloss black, then use a fine detail brush with bright metallic silver or chrome to pick out every individual strap buckle, zipper line, and corset rivet to match the iconic stage look.
Finishing Touches: Coat the skin and main fabrics in a clean matte varnish. Apply a high-gloss clear lacquer exclusively over the leather shoes, the microphone head, and the main jacket panels to create an eye-catching material contrast under spotlight displays.
Safety & Usage Standards
  - Usage Notice:
This is a digital file download intended entirely for 3D printing manufacturing purposes.
Long-term structural balance and center-of-gravity reliability are wholly dependent on the user's end material selections, wall thickness, and print orientation.
Keep the finished print away from direct high-heat showcases or intense heat lamps to eliminate any warping risks over time if using standard PLA.

American Football Goal is a three-dimensional model of upright structures located at each end of the American Football playing field, used for scoring points by kicking the football through them during a field goal attempt or extra point kick.
The American Football goal posts that consist of two vertical uprights connected by a horizontal crossbar, with the special uprights extending upward from the back of the end zone. The American Football goal posts can be located at the back of the end zone and are used as a target for kickers to aim for when attempting to score points.
